checks.setup: Front oblique and side sheets inspected; complete body and apparatus visible.
checks.hands: Left hand supports outside of bent knee; right hand supports outside of ankle.
checks.feet: Opposite leg stays straight with heel supported; bent knee crosses toward opposite shoulder.
checks.movement: Supine cross-body glute/piriformis stretch: keep opposite leg straight, bring bent knee toward opposite shoulder while supporting outside knee and ankle with hands; head and back remain supported.

limitations: Procedural demonstration; support samples are not full collision or biomechanical certification.
Eight-second video illustrates a gentle static hold.
